name: FreeCast Inc. Class A Common Stock
summary: FreeCast, Inc. delivers an internet-based video streaming service. Its central cloud-powered entertainment hub offers an unrivaled and extensive compilation of content. This includes both complimentary and pay-per-view on-demand videos, a wide selection of streaming channels, live broadcasts, numerous radio stations, music videos, and interactive online games. William A. Mobley, Jr. founded the company on June 21, 2011, and its main offices are located in Orlando, Florida.
